ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) surface area across >90% of the visible fluke, with high-intensity (white/yellow) localized specifically at the distal tips and in small focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base layer; high-intensity yellowish-white clusters (barnacles) localized at the far left and far right distal tips. Five distinct circular high-contrast white rings (diameter 10-25 pixels) are distributed across the mid-to-lower sections of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured angle of approximately 80 degrees; notch apex is sharp and well-defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations. The right lobe trailing edge contains at least 14 distinct acute peaks (spikes), while the left lobe shows more rounded, lower-amplitude variations. Variations range from 5 to 20 pixels in vertical amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical curve shows a slight concavity moving from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive high-contrast pixel clusters at the far distal tips of both lobes representing barnacle colonies. Several circular high-contrast 'ghost' rings are present on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A faint, light-colored linear disruption is visible on the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe, angled at approximately 45 degrees towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular depigmented scars on the right lobe; heavy biological encrustation (barnacles) on the outer margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced jagged indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
